I read the plate as a square dinner plate of about 26 cm, though only part of it is in frame. The food is fried or toasted rice in three clumps along the upper right edge.

The clumps are roughly:
- Top clump: about 8 x 4 cm
- Middle clump: about 5 x 3 cm
- Lower clump: about 6 x 4 cm

Together that is about 70 cm² of footprint. At a height of about 1 cm the volume is about 60 cm³. Cooked rice packs at roughly 0.7 g/cm³, which gives about 45 g. I am rounding up slightly to 50 g.

The rice looks browned and crispy, probably fried with oil, so I use about 170 kcal per 100 g.
